newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nedlloyd alters land transport management.
newsitem.headline: Nedlloyd alters land transport management.

text.p: Dutch transport and shipping group Koninklijke Nedlloyd Groep NV said on Friday it intends to alter the management structure of its European Transport and Distribution business.
"The new structure aims at optimising the flexibility of Nedlloyd's organisation and to further enhance customer orientation," the company said in a statement.

A Nedlloyd Executive Committee (Excom) of seven members will replace the current divisional structure and Management Committee from January 1. However, most members will have a product and country responsibility.
